about: The starter chest: handed out once per world, to the first player on a planet, in the same grant as the two starting Ovens (mars.planets.GrantEvents). Conductor ores are rare, so machines are not blocked while the player looks for them (SME docs/science/mars-conductor-and-carbonate-ores.md section 3). Amounts are INVENTED game balance: 4 copper ingots and 10 redstone dust (Game Designer docs/design/seed-kit-recipes.md section 3: 10 covers the gate path and the greenhouse lamps), and a seed packet (6 wheat seeds, 2 sugar cane, 2 sweet berries, 2 potatoes) so the greenhouse and the seed kits can start with no grass on Mars. Labelled 'from the lander' in the chest name.
